name: Read or write a file
description: Reads a file into a run variable, or writes one from a value. The 'executes' half of AI proposes, a human approves, a plugin executes.

args.name: operation
args.label: Operation
args.description: What to do with the path.

args.name: path
args.label: Path
args.description: Relative to the workspace unless absolute.

args.name: content
args.label: Content
args.description: What to write. Required when writing, ignored when reading.

args.name: createDirectories
args.label: Create parent folders
args.description: Create the parent folders when writing, rather than failing on a missing one.
